patch_list: Installs the patched build under its own application id (app.xiondigital.atoz by default), so it can sit next to the official Amazon A to Z instead of replacing it. Renames the provider authorities, the app's runtime permission and the lau…
Turns on Amazon A to Z's night mode before the first screen is created and opts the app into Android's automatic dark transform, so the interface is dark even when the phone is set to light mode.
